values: AMR-050-0034 (5100034): Focal pedal area ratio equality

Focal pedal area ratios of closed elliptic billiards — Alec Kriebel, ORCID 0009-0001-9320-500X; v1.0; preprint 2026-10-04. The displayed focal-ratio equality E is proved for every primitive convex or coprime star elliptic billiard with a strict nondegenerate confocal elliptical caustic. The stronger M gives a positive outer/original pedal-area multiplier independent of phase and common to both foci. Signed supporting-line areas, nonvanishing, reversal and repetition are covered. An exact triangle disproves the interpretation C that the common focal ratio is itself phase constant. The April 2020 observation, known even symmetry, conditional triangular implication of old geometric results, classical negative corollary, canonical coordinates and established elliptic principal-part methods are credited. No absolute firstness, even-M novelty, separate triangular novelty, new negative theorem or new general method is claimed; six unavailable journal editions remain bounded-priority coverage limits. Six-page unrefereed research note, extensive AI assistance, successive new whole-package adversarial reviews; no external human peer review or formal proof-assistant certification. PDF plus portable verification archive, standalone source, historical supplement, exact and finite noninterval diagnostics, actual outputs and provenance. Original author history 1/5 preserved. records.title: Focal pedal area ratios of closed elliptic billiards
records.description:
This research note proves the focal pedal area equality observed by Reznik, Garcia and Koiller in April 2020 for every primitive closed elliptic billiard with a strictly nested nondegenerate elliptical caustic, including coprime star orbits. More precisely, the signed supporting-line pedal areas of the outer tangent polygon and the original chord polygon are proportional by a positive phase-independent constant common to both foci. A common pair of simple poles, local original and adjacent outer cancellations, strict real signed positivity, and compact-torus residue matching yield the proof. Reversal and positive integral repetitions are covered explicitly.

An exact triangular certificate disproves the interpretation that the common focal ratio itself is constant over the family. Prior observation of the equality, its known primitive-even symmetry proof, an explicit triangular consequence of old geometric theorems, the classical nonconstancy corollary, canonical coordinates and established Jacobi principal-part methods are credited. The specialized local arguments already appeared in companion repository work and are reconstructed here. A bounded primary-source priority audit identified no earlier proof across the full stated domain; no absolute firstness, independently new invariant, triangular novelty, new negative theorem, or new general method is claimed. Hyperbolic or collapsed caustics, diameter walks, unsigned lobe areas and segment-clamped projections are excluded.

The supporting archive contains the editable standalone source, the conditional triangular deduction, exact and finite high-precision verification programs, actual outputs, provenance and source/edition limitations. Numerical diagnostics are not interval-certified and do not replace the universal proof. This is an unrefereed preprint. AI tools were used extensively for proof development, literature comparison, computation, reproduction, writing and independent adversarial verification. Internal AI reviews are not external human peer review or formal proof-assistant certification; neither is claimed.
